changes: Ported from JavaScript to C# on 2026-11-06, with the same pets, numbers, dialogue, recipes and Mod.Call commands. Differences: the config screen has no slider suffix, so the two interval and duration labels now carry the unit; a chat line is wrapped once and kept until the next line, so changing the language mid-line changes it only on the next line. Touhou Little Friend's shop integration stays optional and by name, and has no effect while no mod provides touhoupets/YukariPortal.
